arguments.sql_query:
WITH ssri_drugs AS (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, ing.concept_name AS ingredient
  FROM omop.concept ing
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ing.concept_id
  WHERE ing.concept_id IN (797617,715939,755695,751412,722031,739138,40234834,44507700)
), ssri_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN ssri_drugs sd ON sd.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  GROUP BY de.person_id
)
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS ssri_users_with_index FROM ssri_exposures

SELECT TOP 100 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.domain_id, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id, COUNT_BIG(co.condition_occurrence_id) AS n
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
WHERE c.domain_id='Condition' AND (
 LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%nausea%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%diarrhea%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%insomnia%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%somnolence%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%dizziness%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%headache%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%dry mouth%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hyperhidrosis%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%sweating%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%sexual dysfunction%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%libido%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%erectile dysfunction%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%anorgasmia%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%weight gain%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%fatigue%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%tremor%')
GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.domain_id, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id
ORDER BY n DESC

arguments.sql_query:
WITH ssri_ingredients AS (
  SELECT v.concept_id
  FROM (VALUES (797617),(715939),(755695),(751412),(722031),(739138),(40234834),(44507700)) v(concept_id)
), ssri_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM ssri_ingredients si
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = si.concept_id
), ssri_index AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN ssri_drugs sd ON sd.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  GROUP BY de.person_id
), indication_seed AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('Depression', 440383),
    ('Major depressive disorder', 4152280),
    ('Anxiety disorder', 442077),
    ('Generalized anxiety disorder', 434613),
    ('Panic disorder', 436074),
    ('Obsessive-compulsive disorder', 440374),
    ('PTSD', 436676),
    ('Premenstrual dysphoric disorder', 4242733)
  ) v(indication, ancestor_concept_id)
), indication_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.indication, ca.descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
  FROM indication_seed s
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = s.ancestor_concept_id
), ssri_indications AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT si.person_id, si.index_date, ic.indication
  FROM ssri_index si
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = si.person_id
  JOIN indication_concepts ic ON ic.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE co.condition_start_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day, -365, si.index_date) AND DATEADD(day, 30, si.index_date)
), side_seed AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('Headache', 378253),
    ('Diarrhea', 196523),
    ('Insomnia', 436962),
    ('Dizziness', 433316),
    ('Nausea', 31967),
    ('Nausea/vomiting', 27674),
    ('Erectile dysfunction', 3655355),
    ('Tremor', 443782),
    ('Hyperhidrosis/sweating', 138565),
    ('Somnolence', 4158978)
  ) v(side_effect, ancestor_concept_id)
), side_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.side_effect, ca.descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
  FROM side_seed s
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = s.ancestor_concept_id
), denom AS (
  SELECT indication, COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT person_id) AS ssri_users
  FROM ssri_indications
  GROUP BY indication
), counts AS (
  SELECT ii.indication, sc.side_effect, COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT ii.person_id) AS patients_with_side_effect
  FROM ssri_indications ii
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = ii.person_id
  JOIN side_concepts sc ON sc.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE co.condition_start_date BETWEEN ii.index_date AND DATEADD(day, 90, ii.index_date)
  GROUP BY ii.indication, sc.side_effect
)
SELECT c.indication, d.ssri_users, c.side_effect, c.patients_with_side_effect,
       CAST(100.0 * c.patients_with_side_effect / NULLIF(d.ssri_users,0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS pct_of_indication_group
FROM counts c
JOIN denom d ON d.indication = c.indication
ORDER BY c.indication, patients_with_side_effect DESC

Using OMOP EHR data, I defined SSRI exposure as first recorded exposure to citalopram, escitalopram, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, paroxetine, sertraline, vilazodone, or vortioxetine, then counted candidate SSRI-associated side-effect diagnoses recorded within 90 days after SSRI start, stratified by treatment indication recorded from 365 days before to 30 days after SSRI start.

Most common side effects were very consistent across indications:

| Indication | SSRI users | Most common side effects |
|---|---:|---|
| Depression | 38,931 | Insomnia 9.89%, headache 9.31%, nausea 6.29% |
| Major depressive disorder | 19,036 | Insomnia 11.90%, headache 9.03%, nausea 6.59% |
| Anxiety disorder | 27,893 | Insomnia 12.29%, headache 9.84%, nausea 6.76% |
| Generalized anxiety disorder | 7,074 | Insomnia 14.91%, headache 8.85%, nausea 5.33% |
| Panic disorder | 2,519 | Insomnia 16.16%, headache 13.14%, nausea 8.97% |
| PTSD | 3,079 | Insomnia 13.54%, headache 12.47%, nausea 7.53% |
| OCD | 1,702 | Insomnia 8.70%, headache 8.05%, nausea 4.11% |
| Premenstrual dysphoric disorder | 431 | Headache 10.67%, insomnia 7.19%, nausea 3.94% |

Overall, **insomnia, headache, and nausea** are the most common SSRI-associated side-effect diagnoses across nearly all treatment indications. **Diarrhea, nausea/vomiting, and dizziness** form the next tier. Tremor, erectile dysfunction, somnolence, and hyperhidrosis/sweating were less common, generally around or below ~1%.

Caveat: these are diagnosis-code co-occurrences after SSRI initiation, not adjudicated adverse drug reactions, so confounding by indication and baseline symptom burden may inflate counts.
